action: Set alert code 1004, message Invalid amount, and go back
evidence: if RCV-AMOUNT = 0 move 1004 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \

rule_description: Handle account not found during read
action: Set alert code 1001, message Account not found, close files, and go back

rule_description: Handle other account file read errors
action: Set alert code 9001, message Account file error, close files, and go back
evidence: when other move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \

rule_description: Reject transaction if account is blocked
action: Set alert code 1002 and message Account blocked
evidence: when ACC-BLOCKED move 1002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \

rule_description: Reject transaction if account is closed
action: Set alert code 1003 and message Account closed
evidence: when ACC-CLOSED move 1003 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \

rule_description: Reject transaction if account status is invalid
action: Set alert code 9001 and message Invalid account status
evidence: when not ACC-ACTIVE move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \

rule_description: Prevent balance overflow beyond maximum limit
action: Set alert code 1005, message Balance overflow, close files, and go back
evidence: if WS-NEW-BALANCE > 999999999999999 move 1005 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \

rule_description: Handle account update error after rewrite
action: Set alert code 9001, message Account update error, close files, and go back

rule_description: Handle journal write error and rollback account updates
action: Set alert code 9002, message Journal write error, perform rollback account, close files, and go back

rule_description: Validate stamp uniqueness by reading the journal file and looping until a unique stamp is found or exhausted
action: Reads journal file by stamp and evaluates WS-JRN-STATUS to determine if stamp is unique (status 23), existing (status 00), or error (other)
evidence: perform until WS-STAMP-FOUND = 1 ... read JOURNAL-FILE key is JRN-STAMP

rule_description: Handle duplicate journal stamp by incrementing sequence or raising exhaustion alert
action: If sequence equals 9999, set alert code 1006 and message "Journal stamp exhausted" and exit perform; otherwise add 1 to WS-SEQUENCE
evidence: when "00" if WS-SEQUENCE = 9999 move 1006 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal stamp exhausted" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE exit perform else add 1 to WS-SEQUENCE end-if

rule_description: Handle journal file error during stamp uniqueness check
action: Set alert code 9002, set message "Journal file error", and exit perform
evidence: when other move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE exit perform

rule_description: Rollback account balance to old balance if account was updated and account read is successful during a rollback procedure
action: move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE and rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD
evidence: if WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1 move RCV-ACCOUNT-NUMBER to ACC-NUMBER read ACCOUNT-FILE key is ACC-NUMBER if WS-ACC-STATUS = "00" move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD end-if end-if

rule_description: Close journal file if it is currently open
action: Close JOURNAL-FILE and set WS-JOURNAL-OPEN to 0
evidence: if WS-JOURNAL-OPEN = 1 close JOURNAL-FILE move 0 to WS-JOURNAL-OPEN end-if

rule_description: Close account file if it is currently open
action: Close ACCOUNT-FILE and set WS-ACCOUNT-OPEN to 0
evidence: if WS-ACCOUNT-OPEN = 1 close ACCOUNT-FILE move 0 to WS-ACCOUNT-OPEN end-if
